metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds a margin struck out, Gaunt for the second time, and a night that belonged to the tooth.

yesterday: Nick weeps when the scene gives him cause. The direction is out of the roll. Three lines was the gap on Thursday. The tables say a direction is a guess, and that N. S. knew better.
The king this afternoon was the second time he has been played. You were dead by the middle. The next king is Thursday the sixteenth.
The Rose title was The New World's Tragedy.
Three candles burned to the socket. You walked because lying made the gum worse. She will count them when she can get a hearing.
Tomorrow is Titus again, at two, and the moon is full. The sheet at home is still Monday's night.
